correctness.rationale: The nonzero conic two-sum fibers have at most one unordered pair by polarization and nondegeneracy in odd characteristic; the zero fiber is exactly the antipodal collision fiber. Character orthogonality yields the exact fourth-moment identity. Sharp optimization is complete in the p≤1 and p≥2 cases, including equality and boundary r=0, m=1. The norm-one algebra establishes split/nonsplit cardinalities and exact p feasibility. Exhaustive exact checks of 6,810 finite masks corroborate rather than replace the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural erasure classification for every masked norm-one conic (both Witt types and every odd prime power) reduces an exponential family of sharp Fourier inequalities to two statistics, identifies the full attainable range at each retained size, and detects a nontrivial equality-phase threshold at two intact antipodal pairs. The all-mask minimax theorem and full optimizer stratification are meaningful quantitative robustness invariants, not just the known one-deletion special case.
